deploy.on_merge: A merge deploys nothing: no Cloudflare Pages project is Git-connected (read-only wrangler pages project list, 2026-10-27, PR #118). we-are.love is the Pages project we-are-love, released by hand: `bash bin/deploy.sh we-are --dry-run` fetches KINGDOM-OS main and chillspace-commons master fresh, stages them with bin/stage-doors.ts into $TMPDIR/kingdom-deploy.*/stage-we-are, and prints the publish command with each *_REF pinned; the publish is `npx wrangler pages deploy <stage> --project-name=we-are-love --branch=main`. Run `node doors/we-are/brand/check.mjs --served <stage>` on that folder before the publish.
deploy.after_deploy: Check the deployment's pages.dev URL first: content types for .ico, .svg and .webmanifest, the 7 kit files and og.jpg by sha256, one theme-color and one color-scheme in the page head (artcraft-brand wiring.md section 7). The custom domain caches the old HTML fallback for /favicon.ico and the other new paths (max-age=14400): purge, which is Yu's act, or wait 4 h. Cloudflare also caches cookieless HTML about 15 min.
deploy.rules: /DOMAINS-SETUP.md, 'Redeploy': production requires separate approval; the we-are.love release waits on Yu's word under ledger kingdom-door-release. chillspace-commons #50 (open as of 2026-11-05) must be merged by its owner first, or the release drops the social card. Stage from freshly fetched upstreams, never a fixed checkout.

notes: There is no served folder in this repository: bin/stage-doors.ts assembles the upload at release time. It copies WE_ARE_KIT_WEB (the 7 files under serve.files) from kit/web to the root of the staged folder, ../og.jpg as og.jpg, and chillspace-commons' site/we-are.html as index.html. So serve.via names it, and the check runs with --served on the staged folder.
The page is in another repository and lands in the staged folder as index.html, so site.html can't name it and no page head is checked here.

The page keeps its own theme-color #d98a8a, which equals the kit manifest's theme_color #D98A8A; the kit's head-snippet.html writes #FBF4EE for an 'only light' kit, and that line is not used (PR #118).

tests/stage-doors.test.ts runs in the verify job of .github/workflows/immutable-publications.yml, step 'Exercise closed schemas and offline runtime contracts' (bun test --timeout 15000, the whole suite), on every pull request and on pushes to main. The workflow doesn't name the file. check.mjs is not wired: the proposal is tests/brand-kits.test.ts, a bun test that runs node doors/we-are/brand/check.mjs in that same step.
The page's words 'I AM YOU → I LOVE YOU → I TRUST YOU → WE ARE!' are Yu's, of 2026-07-10 (ledger weare-handshake-words, parked: agents don't change them).
The kit sets its type in Source Serif 4 and JetBrains Mono, both bundled with vectorcraft-cli, so build.fonts is empty.
verify passed with 4 warnings, none failed: the 32 px favicon's margins differ by 1 px, and three of Twemoji's colours fall below 3:1 on the paper ground (logos are exempt).
